messages:
Lina (Finance): Heads up 400  invoice from UbuntuWorks (vendor UW-091 ZA). They marked the invoice VAT-exempt and also sent a note saying customers should gross-up for any South African withholding tax. Invoice shows VAT reg: ZA123456789 and total USD 7,200. Can AP pay or do we need more docs?
Priya (Accounts Payable): Quick check  do we have their VAT registration copy or a tax clearance cert? If they're zero-rating exports of services there should be supporting docs. Also not sure about the gross-up ask  what's the legal basis?
Thabo (Vendor Ops): Vendor confirmed services delivered remotely from Cape Town. Their email says: "Due to SARS guidance, please gross-up to account for local withholding; vendor will remit to SARS." No attachment beyond the invoice.
Daniel (Legal): We need evidence. Ask for: (1) certified VAT registration document; (2) a SARS tax clearance certificate or formal statement showing withholding obligations; (3) a reissued invoice that either shows VAT charged or includes a clear "reverse charge" / "zero-rated export" annotation with legal reference. Without docs we shouldn't alter agreed amounts.
TaxBot: Automated check: ZA VAT number ZA123456789 matches expected pattern. SARS does apply withholding in limited scenarios for non-resident suppliers depending on service type; not universal. Recommend vendor provide a copy of the SARS guidance they rely on and a tax clearance/receipt proving remittance.
Lina (Finance): Action items: Thabo to request the two docs + reissued invoice. Priya will hold payment if docs aren't provided. If they insist on gross-up, Legal to assess and Finance to run the gross-up calculation vs contract.
Priya (Accounts Payable): Will also flag in our AP system so payment is blocked until we confirm. If vendor pushes, we'll need a signed amendment to the contract for gross-up.
Thabo (Vendor Ops): Message sent to vendor (pasting draft):
```
Hi UbuntuWorks,
Thanks for the invoice. To proceed we require: 1) VAT registration certificate (certified copy); 2) SARS tax clearance or proof of remittance/statement showing why you require a gross-up; 3) a reissued invoice that breaks out VAT or explicitly states zero-rated export with the legal basis. Please provide within 72 hours. If you expect Redwood to gross-up, include a calculation example and contract clause authorizing that.
Thanks,
Thabo
```
Daniel (Legal): If they produce a SARS remittance receipt that ties to this invoice period, we can consider paying gross and then seeking documentation for our records. Otherwise we shouldn't unilaterally increase payment amounts.
Lina (Finance): Thanks team. I'll wait for vendor reply and post back. :eyes:
